Item 1. Business

We design accelerated computing platforms. GPU demand for artificial intelligence remains strong. Generative AI deployment expanded further this quarter, with AI data center customers increasing capacity. Our AI infrastructure and AI software offerings grew, including inference software built on CUDA. Robotics and autonomous vehicle platforms also contributed. Nuclear power and grid capacity discussions increasingly shape data center siting decisions for our largest cloud computing customers.We design accelerated computing platforms. Item 1A. Risk Factors

Our business depends on demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, which may not grow as expected. Export control regulations restrict sales of certain accelerated computing products to some regions. We depend on a limited number of foundry partners; capacity constraints could impair our ability to meet demand. Customer concentration is significant. NEW THIS PERIOD: power demand and grid interconnection timelines at customer data center sites have emerged as a constraint on deployment pace, and we now face additional export restrictions in certain markets.Our business depends on demand for artificial intelligence infrastructure, which may not grow as expected. Item 7. Management's Discussion and Analysis of Financial Condition

Revenue accelerated again, led by AI data center systems. Gross margin was roughly flat.
